# PAYO v7 — AI-first UI revamp (Direction B + A greeting) with lightweight motion

**Date:** 2026-09-07 · **Status:** approved (owner: three directions → whole-app wireframes →
"approved, go ahead and build it") · **Builds on:** v6.1. Mobile only — no backend or AI change.
**Visual source of truth:** `docs/design/ai-first-v1/*.dc.html` (21 artboards, generated by
`gen.py`; canvas https://claude.ai/code/artifact/eacd446b-83aa-45f7-af87-c05811619ccb).
**Motion source of truth:** §3 below (values from the design-lab, improve-animations,
12-principles and better-ui skills; the three-direction page is the reference animation).

## 1. What changes (product)

1. **Home is a navy head over a cream sheet.** The head carries the avatar, greeting, the
   balance line, and the assistant's live status (Listening… with a real waveform, Thinking…,
   Speaking… tap to interrupt). The sheet carries "Since you were last here" (digest), the
   suggestion cards, and — in conversation — the bubbles and cards. The amber mic is a
   floating button on the sheet; the composer input opens from the keyboard icon.
2. **The greeting arrives word by word** (Direction A's signature) on first paint only.
3. **Every screen adopts the same vocabulary**: navy head where money is shown (Home,
   Wallet, Pockets total), cream sheet below, white cards with the card radius, one amber
   primary, tokens unchanged. Sign-in, Send flow, Bills, Card, Requests, Settings, More match
   their artboards.
4. **Chat cards restyled** per the `Cards` artboard: receipt (centred, status pill), spending
   (bars + compare row), check-in (shield, two stacked buttons), waiting (clock, Remind),
   approvals, help (tappable rows). No text bubble when a card is present (unchanged rule).
5. **Motion is lightweight and rule-bound** (§3). Entrance choreography once per screen
   open; repeated actions instant; press feedback everywhere; reduced motion honoured.

## 2. Screen contract (per artboard; exact values in the `.dc.html`)

| Artboard | Screen | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Phone, Otp, Pin | `app/(auth)/*` | keypad 64 pt (PIN 72), amber-bordered input, demo-code banner |
| Main | Home greet | head 316 pt: avatar row, greeting (26/800), balance line; sheet: digest rows, "Say it, or tap" suggestions; mic FAB 64 at bottom-right above the tab bar |
| HomeListening | Home listening | head grows to 350 with waveform driven by recorder metering; sheet shows "Heard so far" with the live transcript |
| HomeConversation | Home chat | head shrinks to 230 (status only, no balance); sheet holds bubbles + cards; FAB shows rings while live |
| HomePinSheet | PIN in chat | backdrop `rgba(13,42,61,.45)`, sheet 560 pt, 72 pt keys |
| HomeUrdu | Home in Urdu | RTL mirror, Nastaliq, same structure |
| Cards | chat cards | receipt, spending, check_in, waiting_approval, approvals, help |
| Wallet | Wallet | navy head with balance + Send/Request/QR row; sheet: quick actions grid, due bill, recent activity |
| Pay | Pay hub | search, 2×3 tiles 104 pt, AI bar above the tab bar |
| SendIdentifier, SendInstitution, SendAmount, Success | Send flow | institution rows 56 pt with logos; amount 48/800; success with the spoken line and save toggle |
| Bills, Card, Pockets, Requests, Settings, More | More screens | per artboard |

Non-goals: no new colours, no new type faces, no emoji, no fake status bar.

## 3. Motion spec (binding values)

`src/motion/config.ts` becomes the single source:

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `EASE_OUT` | `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` (Reanimated `Easing.bezier(0.2,0,0,1)`) | every entrance |
| `EASE_IN` | `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)` | every exit |
| `D_MICRO` | 150 ms | press, colour, opacity toggles |
| `D_UI` | 220 ms | icon swaps, chips, small state changes |
| `D_ENTER` | 300 ms | element entrance |
| `D_SHEET` | 320 ms | sheet settle, translateY 24 → 0, no overshoot |
| `STAGGER` | 60 ms | first-paint rows only |
| `WORD_STEP` | 55 ms | greeting words |
| `PRESS_SCALE` | 0.96 | all pressables (`usePressScale` changes from 0.98) |
| `ICON_SWAP` | scale 0.25 → 1, opacity 0 → 1 (blur where the platform allows, else omitted) | icon state changes |
| `RINGS` | 1.8 s, scale 1 → 2.1, opacity .5 → 0, 600 ms offset | listening |
| `COUNT_UP` | 250 ms, tabular figures | balance changes |

Rules:
- Choreography runs **once per screen mount** (a `firstPaint` ref); tab switches, re-renders
  and list updates never re-run it. Exits are shorter than entrances and translate ≤ 12 pt.
- One focal point at a time: while the greeting words run, nothing else moves except the
  sheet settle that follows them.
- Only `transform` and `opacity` animate, on the UI thread (Reanimated worklets); no layout
  animations, no `width/height` transitions.
- Every animated change also has a static cue (label, colour, icon).
- `prefers-reduced-motion`: no loops (rings, waveform), entrances become 150 ms opacity.
- The waveform is **real**: bar heights follow `useRecorder` metering (smoothed), so it is
  the "I am listening" cue and the mic needs no label.
- Idle: nothing loops on Home. (The old `Breathe` on the mic is removed.)

## 4. Architecture (mobile)

- New kit: `src/ui/NavyHead.tsx` (props: name, greeting, balance?, status, height, urdu),
  `src/ui/Sheet.tsx` (radius 28, grab handle, animated settle), `src/motion/WordRise.tsx`
  (splits a string into words, staggers `WORD_STEP`), `src/motion/Waveform.tsx` (metering →
  bars), `src/motion/IconSwap.tsx`, `src/motion/useFirstPaint.ts`.
- `app/(tabs)/index.tsx` becomes a state machine view over the existing `useVoiceLoop`,
  `useConverse`, `useHomeDigest`: `greet | listening | conversation`, head height derived.
- CardView renderers restyled in place; card contract untouched (parity test stays).
- Screens rebuilt on the new kit; all existing testIDs kept (`composer-mic`, `chip-*`,
  `check-in-*`, `waiting-*`, `approval-*`, `keypad-*`, `*-back`, `pay-tile-*`, …) so the QA
  scripts keep working.
- i18n: no new user-facing strings beyond "Say it, or tap", "Heard so far", "Since you were
  last here" (exists), en + ur.

## 5. Acceptance

1. Unit: `motion/config` values; `usePressScale` 0.96; `WordRise` splits/schedules;
   `useFirstPaint` runs once; Home state → head height mapping; parity + i18n; jest + tsc.
2. Simulator, each screen side-by-side with its artboard (screenshots in `docs/qa/v7/`):
   Home greet/listening/conversation/PIN/Urdu, Cards, Wallet, Pay, Send ×4, Bills, Card,
   Pockets, Requests, Settings, More, Phone/OTP/PIN.
3. Motion: Home entrance runs once (re-open the tab: no replay); words stagger; sheet settles
   without overshoot; press scale on chips and buttons; rings only while listening; waveform
   moves with speech; reduced-motion setting removes loops. Recorded as a short screen
   recording plus a frame-by-frame note.
4. All v3–v6 flows still pass on the simulator: bank-aware send with in-chat PIN, saved
   recipient, bill, guardian round-trip, scam check-in, language switch.
